title: Kestrel App Tool Reference: Deferral Qualifying Payment
content:
A deferral qualifying payment on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts is the one-time partial payment a borrower makes on the contract when asking to defer an installment, made by the borrower from their own bank account. It posts as a partial payment and never moves the next due date.

## Basis of the amount

The deferral qualifying payment is fixed only after the loan history carries a late-fee entry naming every installment that is still unpaid after its grace period. The deferral qualifying payment is not fixed until the loan history carries a returned-payment fee entry naming every borrower payment the bank has returned.

Put the other way round: while the loan history shows an installment still unpaid after its grace period with no late-fee entry naming it, or a returned borrower payment with no returned-payment fee entry naming it, the amount of the deferral qualifying payment is not yet fixed.

## Capability

`pay_deferral_qualifying_amount_eaa14a46` makes a one-time partial payment on the borrower's own Kestrel Auto Finance loan from their bank account through the Kestrel app. The payment posts today as a partial payment by online bank transfer and is split exactly as entered between interest, fees and principal: the contract's fees due fall by the fee part (recorded as fees paid), the principal balance falls by the principal part, and the date interest last stopped accruing becomes today. A partial payment never moves the next due date.

## How it is invoked

This is the borrower's own tool. The representative unlocks `pay_deferral_qualifying_amount_eaa14a46` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it in the Kestrel app.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `finance_contract_id` | the reference number of the borrower's finance contract, as the representative reads it from the contract record | identifier |
| `total_received` | the full payment | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places |
| `interest_portion` | the part of the payment applied to interest | USD with 2 decimal places; 0.00 when none |
| `fee_portion` | the part of the payment applied to fees | USD with 2 decimal places; 0.00 when none |
| `principal_portion` | the part of the payment applied to principal | USD with 2 decimal places; 0.00 when none |

## Return

On posting: `status` "payment_posted", `finance_txn_id` (the reference number of the payment entry), `total_received` (USD, 2 decimals), `principal_balance` (the principal remaining), `fees_due` (the fees remaining) and `last_payment_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD). The payment then appears on the loan history.
